_note: English day pillars. name and intro come from the US edition; tag is 'Sits on {Ten God} · {life stage}'; strong / weak is the line for a strong or weak chart. art is not repeated here (the Chinese file's art is kept).

甲子.name: Oak by Winter Water
甲子.intro: Bookish and easy to like. Every new thing you learn makes you surer of yourself.
甲子.strong: A love of learning and real knowledge. You suit education, culture and research, and the more you build up, the more respect you earn.
甲子.weak: People like you, and when things get hard an elder often lends a hand. Accept the help graciously.

乙丑.name: Plum Blossom in Snow
乙丑.intro: Tough, patient and practical. You bloom in the cold, when everyone else has gone quiet.
乙丑.strong: A sharp, practical eye. You find value where others look past it — and you can earn it and keep it.
乙丑.weak: You can wait things out. Keep building quietly, and when it counts, you'll be seen.

丙寅.name: Sunrise in the Spring Woods
丙寅.intro: Curious, upbeat and full of energy. You bring the morning with you wherever you go.
丙寅.strong: A quick learner full of ideas. You suit teaching and creative work, and mentors are glad to bring you along.
丙寅.weak: Upbeat and curious. Ask those ahead of you for advice; showing a little softness now and then makes the road smoother.

丁卯.name: Lantern on a Flowering Branch
丁卯.intro: Imaginative, with a look all your own. Even when you're quiet, you give off light.
丁卯.strong: Full of ideas and imagination — design and art suit you. When inspiration strikes, remember to make it real.
丁卯.weak: Loyal and trustworthy, you easily win the regard and help of elders and mentors.

戊辰.name: Mountain with a Hidden Spring
戊辰.tag: Sits on Allies · Coming of Age · Wealth Vault
戊辰.intro: Steady and generous. You can hold a lot — problems, secrets, people — and keep it all safe.
戊辰.strong: You can carry weight and gather resources. You suit long-term, large-scale work, and people trust you with what they have.
戊辰.weak: You're great at teaming up and pulling resources together. Your good relationships are your firmest footing.

己巳.name: Sunny Fields in Early Summer
己巳.intro: Warm, lively and resourceful. You meet things head-on and usually find a way.
己巳.strong: Plenty of energy and plenty of ways forward. You get back up fast, and others often lean on you.
己巳.weak: Elders, teachers and mentors all want to help you, and your open, cheerful nature makes you easy to like.

庚午.name: Sword Tempered in Summer Fire
庚午.intro: Polished and principled. You keep your standards, and pressure only makes you sharper.
庚午.strong: Steady and respected. You suit carrying responsibility and setting direction in a team; people trust how you work.
庚午.weak: Self-discipline is your strength. Focus on honing your craft — just don't be too hard on yourself.

辛未.name: Gem in the Sand
辛未.tag: Sits on Insight · Easing · Wealth Vault
辛未.intro: Calm and seasoned on the outside, finely tuned on the inside. You notice everything.
辛未.strong: Careful and measured, you hold on to what you have. Speak up and make moves, and your stage gets much bigger.
辛未.weak: Share your ideas more and spend time with people who accept you. Your shine will come through bit by bit.

壬申.name: River Rushing from Autumn Hills
壬申.intro: Quick-minded with real staying power. You learn fast, and your world keeps getting wider.
壬申.strong: A strong learner and thinker, great at research and planning. People are glad to give you a boost.
壬申.weak: There's often someone looking out for you and moving you forward. Accept that kindness and take it one step at a time.

癸酉.name: Dew on an Autumn Morning
癸酉.intro: Clear-headed with sharp instincts. You get things done cleanly, without fuss.
癸酉.strong: Rigorous logic and long-range vision. You suit going deep in fields like medicine, law or tech.
癸酉.weak: You have a skill no one else has. Your instincts save you detours, and people often help you behind the scenes.

甲戌.name: Tree on an Autumn Ridge
甲戌.intro: Down-to-earth and low-key, with deep reserves. People feel safe around you.
甲戌.strong: Trustworthy and steady, good at managing money and the household. You're the one everyone feels safe with.
甲戌.weak: You have your own views and stick to them. Independent and clear-sighted, you live richly inside, and life only gets more solid.

乙亥.name: Blossoms on a Winter Lake
乙亥.intro: Kind, intuitive and calm inside. You never push, and you still carry weight.
乙亥.strong: Wise and never pushy. Teaching, scholarship and helping others suit you, and your reputation takes care of itself.
乙亥.weak: You love freedom and have friends everywhere. The care of elders and friends is what keeps you steady.

丙子.name: Sunrise over a Frozen Lake
丙子.intro: Upright and gracious. You play fair — and you can warm up the coldest room.
丙子.strong: Upright and principled. You suit climbing step by step on a big platform, and bosses notice you.
丙子.weak: Thoughtful and measured. Give yourself more credit and take bolder steps — it gets easier.

丁丑.name: Lamplight in a Snowy Window
丁丑.tag: Sits on Ease · Storage · Wealth Vault
丁丑.intro: Unflashy, with a plan you keep to yourself. Your life runs on quiet good judgment.
丁丑.strong: Good with money and patient at building up. You leave nothing to chance and suit long-term investing.
丁丑.weak: Rich inside and never grasping. Focus on doing your own work well, and your reputation will speak for you.

戊寅.name: Mountain in the Spring Forest
戊寅.intro: A commanding presence, born to lead. When it counts, you make the call.
戊寅.strong: Decisive and willing to make the call. You suit leading teams and the big picture — add a little warmth to the authority.
戊寅.weak: Pressure only makes you tougher. Climb one step at a time and the road keeps widening.

己卯.name: Field of Spring Sprouts
己卯.intro: Busy on the surface, calm underneath. The more there is to do, the more organized you get.
己卯.strong: You don't say much, but it counts. You handle the thorny problems and hold things together when it matters.
己卯.weak: Pressure actually sharpens you. You find a way through hard places, and every experience makes you wiser.

庚辰.name: Sword Rising from a Spring Lake
庚辰.intro: Strong presence, a mind of your own. The harder it gets, the more you want to win.
庚辰.strong: A natural at carrying big loads, with a method for managing people and work. When you move fast, still listen to those around you.
庚辰.weak: Your mind is your strength. Learn more, think more, and use finesse — small effort, big results.

辛巳.name: Gem on a Sun-Warmed Stone
辛巳.intro: Gracious and easy to like. You weigh things carefully — sometimes twice, sometimes ten times.
辛巳.strong: You know what to say and how far to go. Big platforms and outward-facing roles suit you — just don't bottle everything up.
辛巳.weak: With a reliable platform and people you trust behind you, you'll relax into yourself and shine brighter.

壬午.name: Lake Holding the Summer Sky
壬午.intro: Bright and easygoing. You know how to build a good life, and everyone around you feels it.
壬午.strong: You can earn and you can deliver, and you take care of both work and life. Your days are steady and pleasant.
壬午.weak: You sense opportunities, understand the rules and read people well. Life is comfortable and easy.

癸未.name: Rain on Dry Ground
癸未.intro: Big-hearted and giving. When you help, you help exactly where it matters.
癸未.strong: You're not afraid of hard things. The tougher the place, the more you achieve — you're the one people rely on.
癸未.weak: You don't fight head-on. Patience and wisdom dissolve problems, and your optimism keeps true friends close.

甲申.name: Tree on a Windy Cliff
甲申.intro: Disciplined and decisive. Pressure makes you better — you stand tall and hold your ground.
甲申.strong: You take responsibility and make the call. You suit leading teams and big things; your words and actions carry weight.
甲申.weak: You grow fastest under pressure. Learn to meet hardness with softness and let wisdom settle the problem.

乙酉.name: Osmanthus under the Autumn Moon
乙酉.intro: Precise and composed. Your craft shows in the details.
乙酉.strong: Rigorous and decisive. You suit professional fields that demand precision and rules.
乙酉.weak: Quick to react and good at drawing on others. Work alongside a trusted mentor, and even setbacks become chances.

丙戌.name: Sun Setting into Autumn Hills
丙戌.intro: Grounded and deep. Your warmth shows up in what you do, not in what you say.
丙戌.strong: You finish what you start and you're good at preserving and building. Long-term fields suit you — say your ideas out loud too.
丙戌.weak: Grounded and devoted to home; once you commit, you stick with it. Say what's on your mind, and your effort gets seen.

丁亥.name: Lantern on a Winter River
丁亥.intro: Honest and reserved. You're quiet, and people trust you anyway — instantly.
丁亥.strong: Steady and respected, you easily earn your bosses' trust. Climbing step by step on a big platform suits you.
丁亥.weak: You don't say much, but every word lands. Elders dote on you — just keep being the clear-headed one.

戊子.name: Mountain on a Snowy Night
戊子.intro: Practical, steady, smart with money. The higher the stakes, the more reliable you get.
戊子.strong: You can earn money and manage it, and you work with method. You suit running things for the long haul and building real savings.
戊子.weak: Quick-minded and well-liked, people trust you. Your good name is your path to prosperity.

己丑.name: Field Resting in Winter
己丑.intro: Humble and practical, a natural at living well. You know what's worth keeping.
己丑.strong: Calm and organized, you can earn and you can keep. When something comes up, people want your call.
己丑.weak: You don't like the spotlight. Go deep in one field and you'll become an expert — slow, steady building suits you best.

庚寅.name: Sword in Stone, Spring Woods
庚寅.intro: A sharp eye for opportunity. Once you see it, you move.
庚寅.strong: A sharp eye and fast hands. You're great at pulling resources together to get things done — when you push hard, mind other people's feelings.
庚寅.weak: You're good at drawing on others and have lots of friends. You understand money, and things go smoother when you work with people.

辛卯.name: Jade Hairpin among Flowers
辛卯.intro: Elegant and nimble-minded. You're always first to spot an opening.
辛卯.strong: A keen business sense, a sharp eye and quick action. Remember to give the long game some patience.
辛卯.weak: Team up with reliable partners, turn income into savings, and focus on going deep — you'll only get steadier.

壬辰.name: Ocean at Spring Tide
壬辰.intro: Big presence, big ambitions. Rough water just gets you going.
壬辰.strong: You have a leader's bearing and a wide view, made for steering big projects. Listen to those around you too.
壬辰.weak: Low-key and resilient. The connections and reserves you build up quietly will come through when it matters.

癸巳.name: Sunshower in Early Summer
癸巳.intro: Gentle and thoughtful. People are drawn to you, and you're easy to be around.
癸巳.strong: Gentle and resourceful, you find your way into good circles, and opportunities often come looking for you.
癸巳.weak: Lots of friends and lots of paths. You know how to lean on others and work together, and someone is always willing to help.

甲午.name: Tree on a Summer Plain
甲午.intro: Clever and magnetic. People notice you, and your ideas are usually a step ahead.
甲午.strong: Ahead of the curve and a strong communicator — you belong on a stage. When you're burning bright, remember to take a breath.
甲午.weak: You focus well. Go deep into a small niche and earn respect through skill and insight.

乙未.name: Vine on Late-Summer Earth
乙未.intro: Grounded and results-minded. You can put down roots anywhere.
乙未.strong: You can get things done and build up savings. Steady, patient building — even owning lasting property — suits you.
乙未.weak: Master one skill and you'll only grow more valued. Content with what you have, your days are full of flavor.

丙申.name: Sun on an Autumn Evening
丙申.intro: Quick and perceptive. You read the room, and you're funny without overstepping.
丙申.strong: A feel for numbers and business. You suit trade and outward partnerships — just don't chase too many things at once.
丙申.weak: Well-liked and good at making friends. Work with your network and resources, and the road keeps widening.

丁酉.name: Candle in an Autumn Window
丁酉.intro: Refined taste and a nose for opportunity. You know how to live.
丁酉.strong: Business-minded and good with money. You spot chances in complicated places, and you live with taste.
丁酉.weak: A good eye and a gift for friendship. Someone is usually ready to help, and life keeps getting more refined.

戊戌.name: Mountain in Late Autumn
戊戌.intro: Solid and quiet. You keep your word — you're the one everyone counts on.
戊戌.strong: Principled and able to carry a lot. You suit real industry and the long game — now and then, listen to other views.
戊戌.weak: Plain on the outside, full of ideas inside. Dig into a field or a craft and you'll see more clearly with every year.

己亥.name: Field by Early Winter Water
己亥.intro: Steady and fair, with a fine sense of proportion. You can adapt to almost anything.
己亥.strong: Thorough in everything, you earn money and people's trust alike. You suit growing on a stable platform.
己亥.weak: Well-liked and adaptable. You don't need to be first to land in a good circle; life is steady and pleasant.

庚子.name: Sword in a Cold Spring
庚子.intro: Bright and lively. There's a spark in how you talk and work, and new ideas keep coming.
庚子.strong: A way with words and fresh ideas. You suit stages that need creativity — when your words get sharp, add some warmth.
庚子.weak: Great at ideas and behind-the-scenes strategy, with a good eye. Your cleverness alone can give you a comfortable life.

辛丑.name: Uncut Jade in Winter Earth
辛丑.intro: You don't say much, but you see deep — into people, and into things.
辛丑.strong: Patient and far-sighted, you're good at planning. Remember to say your ideas out loud.
辛丑.weak: Go out and earn, show up, speak up — and the talent you keep hidden will be seen.

壬寅.name: River through the Spring Woods
壬寅.intro: Talented and fun-loving. You know how to enjoy life, and the ideas never stop.
壬寅.strong: Full of ideas and a way with words. You can turn talent into income, and doing what you love pays off.
壬寅.weak: Quick and articulate; your good relationships are your strength. Make more friends and opportunities follow.

癸卯.name: Spring Dew
癸卯.intro: Fresh and quick-witted. Your talent hides in the details, and you always know where the line is.
癸卯.strong: A gift for creating. Writing, design and research all come naturally, and people speak well of your work.
癸卯.weak: Gentle and easy to be around — the listener in your circle of friends. Taking things slow and steady is its own blessing.

甲辰.name: Oak on a Rainy Riverbank
甲辰.intro: You think big and give freely. Every year, you stand on firmer ground.
甲辰.strong: You can earn and you can keep, and you work steadily. You suit the long game and building real savings.
甲辰.weak: Your surroundings nourish you. Easygoing and never pushy, work with others and opportunities will slowly find you.

乙巳.name: Flower Climbing the Rocks
乙巳.intro: Bright and expressive. Walk into a room, and you're seen.
乙巳.strong: Articulate, full of ideas and hands-on — you belong in front. When you shine very bright, leave others some room.
乙巳.weak: You win with cleverness, not force. Planning, advising, solving people's problems — that's where your value lies.

丙午.name: Midsummer Noon Sun
丙午.intro: Warm, bold and quick to act. Your energy fills the place.
丙午.strong: Bold, driven and great at execution. You suit starting and building things — when your temper flares, pause first.
丙午.weak: Generous and loyal is who you are. Charge ahead with reliable partners and your energy goes where it counts.

丁未.name: Lamp on a Country Path
丁未.tag: Sits on Ease · Coming of Age
丁未.intro: Reliable and steady. If you say it, you'll do it.
丁未.strong: Solid and true to your word — people trust you with things, and you lift up those around you.
丁未.weak: One well-honed craft is all the footing you need. You'll want for nothing, and you know how to enjoy life.

戊申.name: Autumn Hill with a Clear Spring
戊申.intro: Witty and playful, with a real gift for enjoying life.
戊申.strong: Full of ideas and a way with words. You make a living with your mind and your taste, and life feels clear and free.
戊申.weak: Master one craft and you'll have solid footing. Gentle and good at reading people, others are glad to help you.

己酉.name: Fields at Harvest
己酉.intro: You know good things when you see them. Your life has real flavor.
己酉.strong: Creativity and a way with words are enough to get results. Turn your hobbies and taste into real skill.
己酉.weak: Skilled hands and a careful mind. You stand on talent in art, design or performance, and things get easier with time.

庚戌.name: Old Sword in the Autumn Hills
庚戌.intro: Plain-spoken and quiet, with principles you won't bend. People rely on you.
庚戌.strong: Reliable and true to your word, you keep people calm in chaos — the backbone of the team.
庚戌.weak: Dig into one craft or field. The deeper you go, the more respect comes naturally.

辛亥.name: Pearl in a Winter Lake
辛亥.intro: Graceful and perceptive, with a real creative streak.
辛亥.strong: Talent and taste in equal measure — you're good at expressing and creating. Be a little more patient with the people around you.
辛亥.weak: With gentle, patient people beside you and quiet time to work, you'll open up more and more.

壬子.name: Ocean Rising on a Winter Night
壬子.intro: Bold and fearless, and loyal to the core.
壬子.strong: Bold and able to lead a team. You suit breaking new ground — when you charge ahead, leave yourself some margin.
壬子.weak: The harder it gets, the tougher you are. Hold your ground and keep going; you often turn things around.

癸丑.name: Drizzle on Winter Fields
癸丑.tag: Sits on Pressure · Coming of Age
癸丑.intro: Quiet and low-key, with a mind firmly your own. You carry weight without making noise.
癸丑.strong: You rarely show your hand, but when you move, it counts. You suit managing people and money from behind the scenes.
癸丑.weak: Hard places forge your skills. Keep at it quietly and the road will open up.

甲寅.name: Great Tree in the Early Spring Forest
甲寅.tag: Sits on Allies · Coming into Power
甲寅.intro: Confident and sure of yourself. You were made to grow upward.
甲寅.strong: A strong presence and willing to take charge. Once you set a goal you go all out — just listen to other voices too.
甲寅.weak: Deep roots are your strength. You can ride out a bad stretch, and the harder it gets, the stronger you grow.

乙卯.name: Orchid after Spring Rain
乙卯.tag: Sits on Allies · Coming into Power
乙卯.intro: Fresh, lovely and easy to be around. People are simply drawn to you.
乙卯.strong: You have your own style. You never try to please, yet people like you, and opportunities find you.
乙卯.weak: Gentle but tough. Go deep in one field over time and you'll become irreplaceable.

丙辰.name: Sun Breaking through Rain Clouds
丙辰.tag: Sits on Ease · Coming of Age
丙辰.intro: Gentle and cultured, with a head full of wonderful ideas.
丙辰.strong: Lots of talent and lots of ideas — design, tech and consulting suit you. After long stretches, remember to recharge.
丙辰.weak: Gentle and caring, with a taste for life's small joys. Avoid head-on clashes and go at your own pace.

丁巳.name: Kiln Fire in Early Summer
丁巳.intro: You don't give up, and your drive is contagious.
丁巳.strong: You can lead the charge and rally people. Once you set a goal you go all out — plan your way back before you leap.
丁巳.weak: Your friends are your good fortune. Find the right partners and you'll go further together than alone.

戊午.name: High Mountain under Blazing Sun
戊午.intro: Passionate and strong under pressure. You stand out wherever you go.
戊午.strong: High energy and loyal; competition fires you up. Remember to leave yourself time to rest.
戊午.weak: Elders and mentors want to help you. Learning, culture and education suit you — keep building and you'll shine.

己未.name: Golden Wheat in Late Summer
己未.tag: Sits on Allies · Coming of Age
己未.intro: Hardworking and never one to quit. Step by step, you build a full life.
己未.strong: You rely on yourself, and even starting from nothing you build something steady. When you're tired, don't carry it all alone.
己未.weak: One skill or craft is enough to put down roots. You keep a good attitude and handle stress well; life feels solid.

庚申.name: Sword on an Autumn Cliff
庚申.tag: Sits on Allies · Coming into Power
庚申.strong: The harder the task, the more willing you are. You break new ground and have lots of friends — when it's head-on, try another angle.
庚申.weak: Refusing to give up is your strength. Don't rush a bad stretch — keep going and things will turn.

辛酉.name: Diamond under the Autumn Moon
辛酉.tag: Sits on Allies · Coming into Power
辛酉.intro: Exacting, with high standards — and fiercely loyal to your people.
辛酉.strong: Sharp judgment and words that hit the mark — professional work suits you. Keep your edge sheathed and you'll earn more respect.
辛酉.weak: Pour your high standards into polishing your work. With people who appreciate you and a place to show it, you'll shine.

壬戌.name: Lake Ringed by Autumn Hills
壬戌.tag: Sits on Pressure · Coming of Age · Wealth Vault
壬戌.intro: Kind-hearted, intuitive, and very good with money.
壬戌.strong: You can earn and save, and you have a knack for money; your instincts help you dodge risks. When you can, you love to give back.
壬戌.weak: You value inner life over things, with a feel for philosophy and life — friends often come to you for direction.

癸亥.name: Fine Rain on a Winter Lake
癸亥.intro: Calm on the surface, with real depth of heart and vision.
癸亥.strong: Far-sighted and patient. You don't talk much, but when you do, you set the direction — you suit seeing the whole picture.
癸亥.weak: Soft on the outside, strong within. You can endure and adapt, and after hard times you gather your strength again.
